plain_english: With You as Lord, all-pervading in own self — therefore no talk of transmigration-fear. Even though hard-to-bear suffering, delusion, and terror-causing karmas stand.
sanskrit_cite: svātmani viśvagaye tvayi nāthe tena na saṃsṛtibhītikathāsti satsv api durdharaduḥkhavimohatrāsavidhāyiṣu karmagaṇeṣu
